answer: Weight an identity by attestation entropy, not by count: vote weight is the number of distinct regions of the atlas it has attested into, so ten clones repeating the same lanes earn what one honest node earns. Crossing each ridge into a new region spends a bridge budget that never renews inside the epoch, and the fee for the k-th crossing from one funding tree climbs steeply, so bulk minting pays convexly per head. Each tree posts collateral as one walnut shell: slashing one clone cracks it and drains every sibling at once. A farm's weight saturates at real region count, not its budget.
